== Opening Blessing ==
Our most important contributions seem so obvious to us, but the most important ones take orders of magnitude longer than we think they should. Even so, they are still worth it. We remind each other to persevere. We go this long road together.  --Blessed Be

== Closing Blessing ==

There are so many things in our lives demanding urgent, rapid, short-turnaround action.  We need time away from all of that anxious rushing about.  Here we take that time to work toward a vision so long-term we can barely imagine it.  May this work awaken in us a sense of the limited importance of our day-to-day struggles.  -- Blessed Be
